reviews.title: Update has broken bookmarks and last read
reviews.text:
I had been using this app since many years. I think 8-10 years. 
I think you guys need to improve your testing process. Everytime there is an update some or the other previously working feature is broken. It is more frequent in your bigger updates. You try to create cool new features but fail to protect the already working features. 
This happened with the bookmarks functionality in one your previous updates. You claimed that you upgraded the bookmarks from ground up. But I dont know if you yourselves tested the new bookmarks experience. It is entirely broken. It has broken last read feature completely. I just cant rely on it. You leave the recitation at certain ayat, you come back to homepage. Then you open that Surah from the home page again and it takes you to another ayat. Then you come back to homepage again and back to Surah then it takes you to the correct ayat where you left initially
